_schema: wasteland prop labels v1. Keyed by STI basename (lowercase). name = primary palette label; origin = which sector/feature it belongs to; category is descriptive; per_sub {sub: name} names individual props (1-based sub index). aliases fold version/shadow/cross-tileset copies onto one canonical entry. Any custom sheet registered in a tileset but absent here is flagged by prop_labels_lint.py.
